raw:
Heikki Kovalainen was Jarno Trulli's teammate at Lotus in 2010.

The 2010 final standings list only two Lotus drivers, Kovalainen and Trulli, both on 0 points. The race reports I retrieved don't show either driver's entry-by-entry record, so I couldn't confirm from the search results that Kovalainen started every round. That is the basis for "whole season" here, and the standings are the only evidence I have that he was the sole other Lotus driver.

ANSWER: Heikki Kovalainen
